pages.en: Mum is a nurse at the hospital. Today Lily goes to work with her. Mum puts on her uniform and says hello to the other staff.
pages.zh: 妈妈是医院的护士。今天 Lily 跟她去上班。妈妈穿上制服，和其他同事打招呼。
pages.scene: A bright friendly hospital corridor, Mum in a blue nurse's uniform waving to other nurses and doctors, Lily holding her hand and smiling.

pages.en: Mum checks a boy's temperature and gives an old man his medicine. She is very busy, but she is always kind to people.
pages.zh: 妈妈给一个男孩量体温，给一位老人送药。她很忙，但她对大家总是很和气。
pages.scene: Mum the nurse gently checking a smiling boy's temperature in a hospital bed, Lily watching, an old man drinking water in the next bed.

pages.en: In the evening, Lily is tired but happy. "Your job is very important, Mum," she says. "I want to be a nurse too!"
pages.zh: 傍晚，Lily 累了，但很开心。“妈妈，你的工作非常重要，”她说，“我也想当护士！”
pages.scene: Lily and Mum walking out of the hospital in the evening light, holding hands, Lily looking up at Mum and smiling.

questions.q: Lily wants to be a nurse.
